Berkontribusi terhadap continuous improvement pada proses after-sales dan kualitas layanan. review_candidates.title: Customer Service Representative
review_candidates.description: Company Description ZORO MISR is the world’s first fully integrated digital tourism platform, dedicated to creating unique, personalized, and memorable travel experiences for customers from around the globe. The company focuses on Egyptian tourism and travel booking, offering excursions, activities, transportation arrangements, and car rentals. A team of local guides and tourism representatives is available 24/7 to provide expert guidance and support throughout the travel journey. ZORO MISR combines technology and local expertise to optimize the traveler experience from initial planning to the end of the trip. Role Description The Customer Service Representative role at ZORO MISR is a full-time, on-site position based in Cairo, Egypt. In this role, the representative responds to customer inquiries through phone, email, chat, and social media, providing accurate information about tours, activities, transportation, and bookings. Daily tasks include assisting with reservations and changes, resolving issues and complaints, and following up to ensure customer satisfaction. The representative collaborates with local guides and internal teams to coordinate services, clarify details, and address any service disruptions. The role also involves documenting interactions, updating customer records, and contributing feedback to improve processes and the overall customer experience. Qualifications Ability to deliver high-quality Customer Service and Customer Support in a fast-paced tourism environment. Skills in maintaining Customer Satisfaction and enhancing Customer Experience across multiple communication channels. Experience working as a Customer Service Representative or in a similar customer-facing role. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; Arabic language proficiency is highly beneficial. Comfort with using digital platforms, CRM tools, and online booking systems. Problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously. Availability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed. Previous experience in tourism, hospitality, or travel services is an advantage.
